run_sase_encode: run the SASE script to encode sentences from an input file into embeddings using a pretrained model
create_sase_embeddings: create SASE sentence embeddings from a text file with a specified model, SPM model, and batch size
build_sase_model: build a TransformerModel from a pretrained checkpoint and SentencePiece tokenizer for encoding
test_sase_encoding: test the SASE encoding pipeline by loading sentences, tokenizing with SentencePiece, and generating embeddings
summarize_sase_output: summarize the SASE embedding output saved as a PyTorch tensor file from encoded sentences
